Hi Sofia / Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the on-prem options this week. We're preparing the physical handoff for the next sealed delivery to our "Islet-7" site and want to document the acceptance and deferred-patch activation flow so it matches both our internal compliance and your operator SOPs. Key asks: 

- We will deliver a signed artifact bundle (image-bundle-v3.tar) with an attached detached signature (manifest-v3.sig).
- We need Redwood to verify the full signing chain (root CA + intermediate) and produce an acceptance receipt.
- We want the image to be uploaded to the isolated host but remain inactive until a remote physical-ack (DocuSign chain-of-custody) is complete — i.e., deferred activation.

I've attached the manifest and a draft chain-of-custody DocuSign request. Also included is our operator checklist for the site. Can you confirm the verification steps you need (hash checks, HSM wrap confirmation, signer identities) and an expected SLAT for acceptance?

Anita — thanks for the clear write-up. We're aligned on the high-level flow. Confirming the verification and deferred activation items we will perform on receipt: 

1) Artifact ingestion verification (within our sealed ingestion VM):
   - Validate SHA256 of image-bundle-v3.tar against manifest-v3.sig
   - Verify detached signature chain against Redwood-trusted roots (we will provide hash of the root CA we used for the explicit acceptance ticket)
2) HSM wrapping / key escrow verification:
   - If you wrap the operator key with Helios HSM, we will request the HSM wrapping cert and a wrapping-proof (signed timestamp).
3) Recording acceptance:
   - We will produce a signed acceptance receipt (signed by our operator key) and record the receipt in the sealed audit ledger.
4) Deferred activation gating:
   - Activation will remain disabled in the local bootloader until we receive a valid chain-of-custody acknowledgment (DocuSign confirmation or operator-signed PDF).

Operational questions: 
- Do you expect the operator to perform an offline integrity check on site prior to handing the device back? If so, please include expected turnaround time for the operator-confirm (we typically schedule a 48h verification window).
- Who at Helios will provide the HSM wrapping proof? Please loop them in.

We'll need Mina to validate the acceptance receipt format (ledger fields) and Marissa to coordinate logistics acceptance windows.

Sofia Ivanova

Anita / Sofia — a couple of technical clarifications from the infra side so acceptance runs smoothly: 

- On the manifest: please include a per-file SHA256 and a top-level bundle digest. We will cross-check both.
- For deferred activation we use a two-key activation pattern on the sealed host:
  * Bootloader reads a non-volatile activation flag (defaults to 0).
  * Acceptance process writes an activation token into the sealed ledger only after the DocuSign event is validated; the token is signed by our operator key and the activation flag is flipped by an authenticated local agent.
- If you want a manual operator-ack step, structure it like: "site-operator signs operator_checklist_v1.xlsx" -> scanned PDF attached to DocuSign -> DocuSign callback triggers Redwood acceptance pipeline.

One small ask: please include the intermediate CA cert that issued manifest-v3.sig so we can verify chain-of-trust offline. We will also produce a short test vector (small sample bundle with known digest) that you can use to validate transfer tooling before the main delivery.

--Karthik

Redwood Inference
